description: A pane beside the chat: what Claude is working on in your system, zoomed in, what just happened and why it matters, and a topic to learn (system-diff)

open_pane_at_start.title: Open the System diff pane at session start
open_pane_at_start.description: Off: the pane opens only when you type /system-diff (system-diff still follows the system in the background, and the web page shows it). On: it opens beside the chat in every session.
